mcq.q: A group of countries removes tariffs among themselves and also adopts a common external tariff against non-members. This is a:
mcq.explain: In a free trade area, members remove tariffs among themselves but each keeps its own tariffs on non-members. A customs union goes further by adopting a common external tariff. A common market adds free movement of labour and capital, and a monetary union adds a common currency.
mcq.topic: Free trade area, customs union, common market, monetary union
mcq.fast: Free trade area + common external tariff = customs union.

mcq.q: A customs union that also allows free movement of labour and capital among its members is a:
mcq.explain: A common market is a customs union with free movement of factors of production — labour and capital — in addition to free trade in goods and a common external tariff. Further integration with common economic policies and currency leads to economic and monetary union.
mcq.topic: Free trade area, customs union, common market, monetary union
mcq.fast: Customs union + free factor movement = common market.

mcq.q: The World Trade Organization came into existence on:
mcq.explain: The WTO was established on 1 January 1995 under the Marrakesh Agreement that concluded the Uruguay Round of negotiations (1986–1994). It replaced GATT as an institution, while GATT rules on trade in goods continue as part of the WTO agreements. Its headquarters is in Geneva.
mcq.topic: The Uruguay Round and the birth of the WTO

mcq.q: Under the WTO principle of "national treatment", a member country must:
options: Give every member the same lowest tariff
Treat foreigners better than its own citizens
Treat imported goods, once they have entered its market, no less favourably than similar domestic goods
mcq.explain: National treatment requires that imported goods, after clearing customs, are treated no less favourably than similar domestic goods in matters such as internal taxes and regulations. The most-favoured-nation principle is different: it requires a member to extend any trade advantage given to one member to all other members.
mcq.fast: National treatment = imports vs domestic goods; MFN = all members equally.

mcq.q: The highest decision-making body of the WTO, which meets at least once every two years, is the:
mcq.explain: The Ministerial Conference, made up of trade ministers of all members, is the WTO's top decision-making body and must meet at least once every two years. Between its meetings, the General Council conducts day-to-day work, also sitting as the Dispute Settlement Body and the Trade Policy Review Body.
mcq.topic: The WTO: objectives, functions and structure

mcq.q: The WTO agreement that deals with patents, copyrights and trademarks is:
mcq.explain: TRIPS is the WTO agreement on trade-related intellectual property, covering patents, copyrights, trademarks and other intellectual property. TRIMS covers trade-related investment measures, GATS covers trade in services, and the Agreement on Agriculture covers farm trade and subsidies.
mcq.topic: WTO agreements and the Doha Round
